nodes.text: Primary bone tumors and selected metastatic tumors should be evaluated and treated by a multidisciplinary team with expertise in the management of these tumors. The team should meet on a regular basis and should include: Core Group • Orthopedic oncologist • Bone pathologist • Medical/pediatric oncologist • Radiation oncologist • Musculoskeletal radiologist
lines: Primary bone tumors and selected metastatic tumors should be evaluated and treated by a multidisciplinary team with expertise in the
management of these tumors. The team should meet on a regular basis and should include:

nodes.text: Specialists Critical in Certain Cases • Thoracic surgeon • Plastic surgeon • Interventional radiologist • Physiatrist • Vascular/general surgeon • Neurosurgeon/orthopedic spine surgeon • Palliative care physician • Additional surgical subspecialties as clinically indicated
lines: • Additional surgical subspecialties as clinically indicated

nodes.text: Refer to orthopedic oncologist • Biopsy, if indicated, should be performed at treating institution
See Bone Cancer Table of Contents for specific bone sarcomas

• History and physical • Bone scan or FDG-PET/CT (category 2B) and/or • Skeletal survey, x-ray, or CT (if multiple myeloma suspected) • Chest x-ray • Serum protein electrophoresis (SPEP)/labs • Chest/abdomen/ pelvis (C/A/P) CT with contrast • Prostate-specific antigen (PSA) • Mammogram

footnotes.text: Labs include complete blood count (CBC) and comprehensive metabolic panel (CMP) with calcium to assess for hypercalcemia.

age_years.definition: Patient age at the decision point, in years.

abnormal_xray.definition: A plain x-ray of the lesion shows an abnormality, as stated in the case.

symptomatic_bone_lesion.definition: The bone lesion causes symptoms (for example pain or fracture risk), as stated in the case.

other_bone_lesions_present.definition: Imaging shows lesions in bone other than the index lesion, as stated in the case.

tumor_site.definition: Anatomic site of the primary tumor. appendicular = limb bones; axial = trunk/pelvis bones other than sacrum or mobile spine; sacrococcygeal_and_mobile_spine and skull_base_clival are the chordoma sites.

compartment.definition: Whether the primary tumor is confined to its anatomic compartment. not_applicable when the site has no compartment concept.

histology.definition: Tumor histologic subtype as reported by pathology.

histologic_grade.definition: Histologic grade as reported by pathology. grade_I/grade_II/grade_III are used when the case gives a numeric grade; low_grade/high_grade when the case gives only a low or high descriptor.

osteosarcoma_subtype.definition: Osteosarcoma subtype as reported by pathology and imaging.

metastatic_at_presentation.definition: Metastatic disease was identified at the time of initial diagnosis, as stated in the case.

lung_only_metastases.definition: All known metastases are located in the lungs, as stated in the case.

oligometastatic_disease_judged.definition: Clinician judgement, applying the guideline's definition of oligometastatic disease, that the metastatic disease is oligometastatic. Not stated in case text, so it is entered by the clinician.

symptomatic_metastases.definition: Metastatic sites cause symptoms, as stated in the case.

resectable.definition: Clinician judgement that the lesion or metastatic site can be resected with the surgical criteria the guideline gives. Not stated in case text.

unacceptable_morbidity_for_resection.definition: Clinician judgement that resection of the lesion would carry unacceptable morbidity. Not stated in case text.

primary_excision_performed.definition: The primary tumor has already been surgically excised, as stated in the case.

surgical_margin_status.definition: Pathologic status of the surgical margins after excision, as stated in the pathology report.

histologic_response.definition: Pathologic response to neoadjuvant or adjuvant chemotherapy, as stated in the pathology report.

treatment_response.definition: Imaging or clinical response at restaging. progressive includes relapse. improved means improvement that does not meet partial response.

incomplete_healing_on_imaging.definition: Imaging shows incomplete healing or incomplete ossification at the treated site, as stated in the case.

amputation_candidate_judged.definition: Clinician judgement that the patient is a candidate for amputation in a selected case. Not stated in case text.

recurrence_type.definition: Site of recurrence. local = recurrence at the primary site. systemic = distant or metastatic recurrence.

guideline_section.definition: Which disease or subtype section of this guideline the case belongs to: the disease named in the guideline's page headings that the patient has (e.g. the tumor type or subtype).

malignant_transformation_present.definition: Giant cell tumor of bone shows malignant transformation, as stated in the case.

age_group.definition: Age category used by the abnormal x-ray branch.

grade_group.definition: Low or high grade category derived from histologic grade.

resectability_category.definition: Resectability category for a lesion or metastatic site. The combined category covers resectable lesions with unacceptable morbidity and unresectable axial lesions.

resectability_status.definition: Resectability of a lesion or metastatic site without the axial grouping. Used where a box says only 'Unresectable': 'unresectable' is returned only when the site is not resectable, whatever its site.

response_group.definition: Response category used by restaging, follow-up and entry branches.

metastatic_extent.definition: Extent of metastatic disease. Oligometastatic when the clinician judgement is positive; otherwise widespread.

gctb_response_status.definition: Status at response assessment for giant cell tumor of bone, separating stable or improved disease with and without incomplete healing.

chondrosarcoma_pathway.definition: Chondrosarcoma pathway at entry: metastatic at presentation, atypical cartilaginous tumor, dedifferentiated, mesenchymal, or the composite high-risk group.

notes.predicates: Conditions were drafted and reviewed by a language model (model_reviewed), not by clinicians. 'rejected' means the review rejected the draft; the box then needs clinician judgement. 'section_only' means the box only requires the patient to be in the page's guideline section.
notes.coordinates: bbox and line_bboxes are PDF points with the origin at the page's top left; pages[].size gives the page size.
notes.links: page links name a page id from pages[]; a multi-page code such as PROS-F has ids 'PROS-F 1 of 5' ... ; external_guideline links name another guideline's slug.
